narrative.overview: A calm, personal collection browser for two people. Images lead; chrome is frosted material floating over the content and recedes. Colour comes only from the single indigo accent and from real images. Apple-inspired depth (hairline, inner highlight, layered soft shadow, blur) without Liquid Glass theatrics. Operate register: standard controls, scannable rows, a clean grid. Light and graphite dark share the same materials.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted sidebar, floating pill toolbar, floating detail sheet and dialogs are the only blurred surfaces.
White cards with a 6px inner inset around the image; neutral fallback tiles where images are missing.
One accent, used only where something can be acted on.
System font stack, no web font.
150-200ms ease-out; springs only on button press.

rules.name: The Acting-Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks what can be acted on or focused. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Image-Colour Rule
rules.body: Apart from the accent, hue comes from real images; missing images get neutral fill tiles (kind icon plus initial), never a colour per list.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic tokens; no raw hex or Tailwind palette in components.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Prices and counts use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Blur-Budget Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur only on sidebar, toolbar, detail sheet, dialogs and drawer. Never on cards, menus or content.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Depth always includes the 1px hairline ring so a surface reads on any image behind it.

dos: Do take colour, radius, shadow and spacing from the tokens in src/styles/tokens.css.
Do keep new floating chrome on material or material-strong with a shadow from the vocabulary.
Do inset images in cards by 6px with a nested radius.
Do pair every state colour with text or an icon.
Do keep motion at 150-200ms ease-out and honour reduced motion.
Do fall back to a neutral fill tile when an image is missing.
donts: Don't add a second accent, per-list colours or decorative gradients on content.
Don't blur cards, menus or list content.
Don't use a web font or hard offset shadows.
Don't hard-code hex or Tailwind palette classes in components.
Don't add raster assets without a README row giving source URL and date.
